profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 - Trucker Tools
profile.summary: I'm a dedicated software engineer who thrives on contributing to a healthy and positive environment. As a team player, I am committed to going above and beyond to support my colleagues and ensure the success of the company. I am a valuable asset to any team and continuously strive to enhance my engineering skills and knowledge.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Developed front-end applications using JavaScript/TypeScript for React web and React-Native mobile platforms.
•	Collaborated with product managers and UX/UI designers to meet project requirements.
•	Incorporated Jest Unit Testing for code coverage and maintainability, and Sentry.io for application monitoring.
•	Worked with backend engineers to integrate REST APIs (PHP Laravel) with SQL databases.
•	Utilized AWS for data storage, Auth0 for authentication, and Netlify with GitHub for deployment pipelines.
•	Managed mobile app development and deployments using Android Studio and Xcode.
•	Acted as a pseudo project manager, conducting client-facing meetings, gathering requirements, and addressing technical/business queries.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Level of security clearance required: Secret
•	Implemented requirements based on design documents, focusing on ethernet message and CORBA interfaces (C++, Rhapsody).
•	Supported the SPOC program, a US military communications system, using Linux and Green Hills RTOS.
•	Conducted customer demos to showcase system functionalities.
•	Served as a point-of-contact for a software component, supporting release/integration processes (Python, ClearCase).

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
•	Level of security clearance required: Secret
•	Contributed to Raytheon’s SSDS project, addressing front-end (Java Swing, legacy TCL) and back-end (C/C++) issues.
•	Followed systematic version control procedures using ClearCase.
•	Operated in a Linux environment (Red Hat) and utilized SSH protocol through PuTTY.
